local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoGold 4.0"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 160)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.18, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AutoGold 4.0"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16

local toggleFrame = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
toggleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 34)
toggleFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -36, 0.35, 0)
toggleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 20)
toggleFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleFrame)

local toggleCircle = Instance.new("Frame", toggleFrame)
toggleCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
toggleCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)
toggleCircle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleCircle)

local timerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
timerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
timerLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.58, 0)
timerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
timerLabel.Text = "Time: 00:00:00"
timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 255)
timerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
timerLabel.TextSize = 14

local goldLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
goldLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
goldLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.73, 0)
goldLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
goldLabel.Text = "Gold: 0"
goldLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
goldLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
goldLabel.TextSize = 15

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -26)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "OFF"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
statusLabel.TextSize = 13

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position
	end
end)
frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

local userEnabled = false
local autoRunning = false
local goldCount = 0
local startTime = 0
local hrp = nil
local humanoid = nil

local function getCharacter()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end
getCharacter()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(3)
	getCharacter()
	if userEnabled then
		autoRunning = true
		startTime = os.time()
		statusLabel.Text = "RESPAWNED - SCANNING..."
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 120)
		task.spawn(waitForFullHealthAndScan)
	end
end)

local function formatTime(seconds)
	local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	local s = seconds % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
end

local function findPromptInGold(goldBar)
	if not goldBar then return nil end
	local p = goldBar:FindFirstChild("PickupGoldPrompt", true)
	if p and p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return p end
	return goldBar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
end

local function safeFirePrompt(prompt)
	if not prompt then return false end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		if typeof(prompt.RequiresLineOfSight) == "boolean" then prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false end
		if typeof(prompt.MaxActivationDistance) == "number" then prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 100 end
		fireproximityprompt(prompt)
	end)
	if ok then
		goldCount = goldCount + 1
		goldLabel.Text = "Gold: " .. goldCount
	end
	return ok
end

local function hasGold()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GoldBars")
	if not folder then return false end
	for _, obj in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local prompt = findPromptInGold(obj)
		if prompt and prompt.Enabled then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function waitForFullHealthAndScan()
	while humanoid and humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth do
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	statusLabel.Text = "FULL HP - SCANNING..."
	task.spawn(waitForGoldAndStartFarm)
end

function waitForGoldAndStartFarm()
	while autoRunning and not hasGold() do
		statusLabel.Text = "WAITING GOLD..."
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 120)
		task.wait(2)
	end
	if autoRunning and hasGold() then
		statusLabel.Text = "GOLD SPAWNED!"
		task.wait(1)
		task.spawn(scannerLoop)
	end
end

function scannerLoop()
	local noGoldCount = 0
	while autoRunning do
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GoldBars")
		if not folder then 
			task.wait(1)
			continue 
		end

		local goldList = {}
		for _, gb in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			local prompt = findPromptInGold(gb)
			if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
				local part = gb.PrimaryPart or gb:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if part and hrp then
					local dist = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
					table.insert(goldList, {gold = gb, prompt = prompt, part = part, dist = dist})
				end
			end
		end

		if #goldList == 0 then
			noGoldCount = noGoldCount + 1
			statusLabel.Text = "NO GOLD (" .. noGoldCount .. ")"
			statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 80)
			if noGoldCount >= 10 then
				statusLabel.Text = "AUTO KILL..."
				task.wait(0.5)
				if humanoid then humanoid.Health = 0 end
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
			continue
		end

		noGoldCount = 0
		statusLabel.Text = "FARMING (" .. #goldList .. ")"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)

		table.sort(goldList, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
		for _, entry in ipairs(goldList) do
			if not autoRunning then break end
			local gb, prompt, tpPart = entry.gold, entry.prompt, entry.part
			if hrp then
				hrp.CFrame = tpPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
			safeFirePrompt(prompt)
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		if autoRunning and startTime > 0 then
			timerLabel.Text = "Time: " .. formatTime(math.floor(os.time() - startTime))
		end
	end
end)

local function setUserToggle(state)
	userEnabled = state
	if state then
		autoRunning = true
		startTime = os.time()
		statusLabel.Text = "FARMING..."
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
		TweenService:Create(toggleFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 150, 20)}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(toggleCircle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2)}):Play()
		task.spawn(scannerLoop)
	else
		autoRunning = false
		if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
		statusLabel.Text = "OFF"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		TweenService:Create(toggleFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 20)}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(toggleCircle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)}):Play()
	end
end

toggleFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		setUserToggle(not userEnabled)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		setUserToggle(not userEnabled)
	end
end)

setUserToggle(false)

I've made some modifications to the script so that players can farm gold infinitely without it stopping when there's no gold available. I added an automatic reset feature: when you’re in the safe zone in the sky, the script will reset your character. This way, you start fresh and can keep farming gold again because gold doesn't res* unless you reset or res* your character. 

Additionally, I noticed that sometimes when you reset your character, it would freeze unless you toggle the farm button off and then back on, which restores your position correctly. I've fixed that issue too. Now, you can AFK farm gold endlessly without any interruptions. The script handles resets smoothly, so your farming won't be interrupted or frozen anymore.

I tried manually clicking the reset button to make my character return to the spawn point, but I ended up getting stuck in the sky without it actually resetting or bringing me back to my original spawn position. It only works if I turn off autofarm then it will resets properly and teleports me back to spawn position.

So, I fixed that by making it so that when you click reset button, it automatically brings you back to your starting position without needing to toggle autofarm off. I also added an automatic reset feature, so it will reset you whenever no more gold is found. This way, you won’t have to manually click the reset button anymore.
